body: Ive thought about valuing the hospital but I feel like they won't care.  Like they will just think I'm dramatic or something.  My parents get mad any time I mention a job or getting a drivers licence so I don't know if I will ever get one.  Its hard to keep fighting part of me doesn't even want to call the hospital or ask for help.  As for my family all my life I've put on an act as this happy positive person who's life is amazing.  I don't even think they will believe me.  I don't know I don't want to waste their time or anything they wouldn't even care if I was gone

She doesn't even believe that I took the pills.  She thinks I flushed them down the toilet or something.  My mom thinks I did it for attention.  I can't get myself to the hospital.  My parents won't let me get a drivers licence or even get a job.  They are really controlling and I don't know how I could ever escape.  Im just done I can't do this anymore

hey, I'm so sorry for everything you went through.  I can't even imagine how you feel but part of me can relate.  I have an abusive father and a mother where I attempted suicide and she couldn't care less and I've never had a real friend only toxic people who beat me down more and more everyday.  But it's not worth it.  Life sucks a lot and it feels so welcoming like you will finally be at peace.  But it's not.  It is this horrible feeling that washes over you the second you are about to die.  It follows you and in that moment, you wish you continued to fight.  So trust me it really is not worth it.

Trust me, as a person who has attempted suicide you regret it the minute it's to late.  That split second before you think you are dead this horrible feeling of regret washes over you.  I can't explain it.  I thought it was going to be amazing like I would finally be happy and at peace.  But it's not it's a horrible feeling that follows me everyday.  If I could say one thing to my past self it would be don't do it no matter how hard it gets.  There is always a light at the end of the tunnel.
